sources: https://www.ci.chisholm.mn.us/campground, read 2026-11-11 (light check of an entry created 2026-11-11 from a fresh read of this page and CampLife 6651542)
summary: Light check: city page re-read and agrees with the entry (city-owned and run, 16 water + 30/50A sites, open May-Oct, daily rates only here, CampLife booking, 10-year rule, phone 218-421-7158). Ordinary nightly stays outside events confirmed by the creating read (CampLife sold Sat 2026-10-17 at $35). No changes.
flags: No changes. City page: 'For the Fairgrounds and Redhead Campground, we have 16 sites that offer water and electric hookups (50 or 30 amp)'; 'OPEN MONTHS OF MAY-OCT'; 'Daily Rates (we only offer daily rates at Fairgrounds and Redhead Campground)'; 'Need Help? Call 218-421-7158 or 218-254-7909'; 'Campers/RVs are subject to the "10 year rule"' (a 2023 rig passes until 2033).

Minor wording only: the city page's Fairgrounds paragraph lists 'Clean restrooms, hot showers, a dump station, and picnic tables', while CampLife (read at creation) sends campers to the Iron Trail Campground in town for showers and restrooms with a door code. The stored facilities note follows CampLife; left as is.

The city's posted rate table ($25 tent / $30 30A / $35 50A, labelled 'Electric/Water/Sewer') reads as the Iron Trail list; the stored $35 comes from CampLife's quote for this campground and the 16 sites have no sewer. Left as is.

Event overflow camping at the Redhead MTB trailhead ('during Redhead event weekends') is separate and not part of this entry. Fairgrounds campground rents ordinary nights outside events (CampLife quote at creation).
